identity.name: The Indian Express
identity.description: A major Indian English-language daily known for political reporting, investigations, opinion and coverage of national and international affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Owned by Indian Express Limited, controlled by the Goenka family after the 1999 split from the southern New Indian Express editions.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Long record of adversarial reporting on Indian governments and a strong opinion section; family ownership creates commercial pressures but no evidence of direct state control.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC rating; self-assessed as centre to centre-right on economic policy with liberal, plural opinion pages.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Editorial and business coverage generally favour liberalisation, investment and fiscal prudence, with space for heterodox opinion.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Strong Indian national lens with growing international coverage and a pro-democracy, civil-liberties orientation.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established newspaper of record with named reporters, corrections and investigative track record; no external factual rating parsed.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No clean MBFC rating parsed for The Indian Express.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Indian national newspaper with a liberal, investigative and opinion-rich mix. It frames world events through Indian strategic interests and domestic political accountability.

selectionRationale: Adds a major Indian national perspective and investigative capacity to complement Scroll and global wires.

research.researchNotes: Official About page confirms founding and ownership context. Feed returns a large mixed file; duplication with The Hindu and Scroll requires de-duplication review. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
